value.text:
The sources describe a cost chain: shields absorb, and past them damage knocks crystals out of the hold for anyone to take, and past that the ship dies back to tier one with nothing.
usecase UC-E4-1 "Pilot trades fire with another ship" status=HAVE
ground UC-E4-1 weapons
ground UC-E4-1 fire
requires UC-E4-1 S:in_field
establishes UC-E4-1 S:trading_fire
includes E4 UC-E4-1
state S:trading_fire "shots are being exchanged"
accept UC-E4-1 "lasers, torpedoes and special weapons are all available routes to damage"
usecase UC-E4-2 "Shields absorb before the hold does" status=HAVE
ground UC-E4-2 shield
requires UC-E4-2 S:trading_fire
establishes UC-E4-2 S:shield_down
includes E4 UC-E4-2
state S:shield_down "the shield is depleted"
accept UC-E4-2 "no crystals are lost while the shield still has charge"
usecase UC-E4-3 "Damage past the shield knocks crystals loose" status=HAVE
ground UC-E4-3 "gems as shield"
requires UC-E4-3 S:shield_down
establishes UC-E4-3 S:bleeding_gems
includes E4 UC-E4-3
state S:bleeding_gems "the pilot is losing crystals to incoming fire"
accept UC-E4-3 "with the shield down, damage taken removes that amount of crystals from the hold"
accept UC-E4-3 "crystals knocked loose are collectable by anyone, including the attacker"
because UC-E4-3 "crystals acting as a second shield is what makes a full hold dangerous to carry"
instead UC-E4-3 "the hold being safe until death, which would make hoarding free"
usecase UC-E4-4 "A ship that runs out of everything dies" status=HAVE
ground UC-E4-4 death
requires UC-E4-4 S:bleeding_gems
establishes UC-E4-4 S:ship_destroyed
includes E4 UC-E4-4
state S:ship_destroyed "the pilot's ship is destroyed"
accept UC-E4-4 "a destroyed ship leaves the field"
usecase UC-E4-5 "Death returns the pilot to tier one with nothing" status=HAVE
ground UC-E4-5 death
ground UC-E4-5 tier
requires UC-E4-5 S:ship_destroyed
establishes UC-E4-5 S:back_at_tier_one
includes E4 UC-E4-5
accept UC-E4-5 "the respawned ship is tier one regardless of the tier that died"
accept UC-E4-5 "every upgrade bought before death is gone"
accept UC-E4-5 "the respawned pilot holds minimal crystals, not none and not the hold they had"
